Hi Tessa / Lauren,

Thanks for taking a quick look at this — EdgeWave would like to propose a joint regional demo series were calling the "Interop Demo Circuit." High level: three 1-day, half-booth events in SF, Austin, and Chicago (small rented demo booth + rotating product demos every 45 minutes). The goal is to drive product-qualified leads and get joint press/LinkedIn momentum.

Key asks from our side:
- MDF allocation (suggested split: 60/40 EdgeWave/Redwood) for venue + local ads
- Shared lead capture (HubSpot integration) and a single co-branded landing page
- Two speaker slots per market (one EdgeWave, one Redwood)
- Lead ownership: first-touch attribution to host; share contact info for joint follow-up within 48 hours

Im attaching a short proposal and a preliminary schedule for your ops team to review (EdgeWave_proposal.pdf, prelim_schedule.xlsx).

Would you be available for a 30-minute ops sync this week to align dates and MDF mechanics?

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Head of Partnerships, EdgeWave

- Lead sharing: do you require full contact export (PII) or hashed tokens plus HubSpot IDs?
- Reporting SLA: wed want daily lead dumps and a joint weekly recap for the first two weeks post-event.
- MOU: will EdgeWave sign a lightweight MOU (1-2 pages) outlining spend split and lead-handling?

Operational asks from our side:
- Redwood can commit 2 FTE staffing per market (product demo + account rep) and a short-run deck + demo laptop.
- Please share co-branding guidelines and a speaker bio template so our comms team can prepare assets.

Ive put a rough run-of-show draft together and attached it (redwood_run_of_show_draft.docx). If youre flexible on the MDF split by city (e.g., higher ad spend in SF), we can probably make the 50/50 case on our end with a marketing match.
